Smart Glasses Appear at Indian Protest Sites

Smart glasses, initially seen as a novelty or prank, have reportedly appeared at protest sites in India. Their presence raises questions about their potential use by law enforcement or other authorities in monitoring gatherings. The context suggests a shift from playful experimentation to a more serious application in public spaces.
